  "reasoning": "All 16 mathematical answers agree with their respective captured worked solutions. Completing the square gives the four vertices (5,-1), (-1,-1), (1,-3), and (5,2). The hyperbola asymptote slopes are ±sqrt(64/4)=±4 and ±sqrt(25/8)=±5sqrt(2)/4. The matrix represents rotation through -pi/6, and De Moivre's theorem multiplies theta/2 by 16. For q-81769, integrating and imposing v(4)=-6 gives v=-(t+2)(t-3), positive for 0<t<3. For q-120757, imposing v(4)=0 gives v=t(t-4)(t+1), negative for 0<t<4. Its source incorrectly says the given condition is v(0)=0, although its substitution correctly uses t=4; this is an authored source error without an answer disagreement. For q-120784, v=1/2+15t-3t²/2 has its global maximum 38 m/s at t=5 s. Twice differentiating the position vectors gives (1,48) at t=2 and (-6t,4), respectively. Inclusion-exclusion gives P(A∩B)=1/5, so P(A∪B′)=1-P(B\\A)=4/5. For q-75278, x′=-8sin(4t)=0 at t=0 and pi/4 in the specified domain, with y′ nonzero at both. For q-122931, C=(e,0), the tangent slope is 2, and the normal is y=-x/2+e/2. Its source briefly calls the requested line a tangent, but ultimately derives the correct normal. The batch judgment is source_error because of these authored wording errors; none of the final answers disagrees with MA. No earlier submitted answer or grade was supplied.",
